what: Per-line sanitization happens after read has already split on newline
scenario_or_breakage: The plan claims crafted embedded newlines cannot create extra logical log lines, but any LF in tmp_stderr is consumed as a record boundary before sanitize_diagnostic_line runs, so injected fragments still become separate larch_err records
suggested_fix: Frame each emitted diagnostic line with a fixed prefix or sanitize the stderr stream before line splitting; update the regression to assert every emitted record is framed and control-free

what: Untrusted job names still reach TSV and emit output unsanitized
scenario_or_breakage: The audit says only the stderr larch_err path takes untrusted external input, but successful gh output is also GitHub-controlled and malformed names containing control bytes are written to OUTPUT_TSV_TMP or emit before the final sanitize_list KV summaries
suggested_fix: Sanitize or replace malformed job names before any TSV/emit contract output, for example write a fixed malformed placeholder plus reason; add a success-path fixture with control bytes in job names

what: Proposed tr helper is locale-dependent on macOS/BSD
scenario_or_breakage: In UTF-8 locales BSD tr can reject invalid byte sequences from untrusted stderr, producing its own diagnostic or dropping data unpredictably; the plan explicitly targets Bash 3.2/macOS portability
suggested_fix: Set LC_ALL=C for the helper, e.g. LC_ALL=C tr -d '[:cntrl:]', and add a fixture with invalid non-UTF-8 bytes

what: [OUT_OF_SCOPE] Another REASON_TOKEN parser still assumes tokens cannot contain equals
scenario_or_breakage: If this PR makes embedded equals a supported REASON_TOKEN value across the Mermaid sanitizer contract, the warnings-log aggregation still truncates at the first equals/space
suggested_fix: Track a follow-up to centralize KV parsing or update this parser if embedded-equals REASON_TOKEN values become a sanitizer-wide contract
